label: Bounded transition protection
definition: For a supplied process model, history, natural-number bound and numerical bearer, ProtectedInterval means that the same bearer exists at every sampled state from zero through the bound, inclusively. It is not direct productive esse-giving, unbounded immortality, or timeless conservation.
note: Analyst formulation; attribution deferred. Model carries primitive actual occurrence edges, destructive terminal states, existence assignments and source/target Threat records. Their ordinary application is OPEN: the finite flame path is ready→burning→lost, guarding changes the continuation to safe, a bypass goes ready→lost and a replacement goes safe→lost. These are process examples in a stipulated state machine, not empirical fire dynamics or a metaphysical possibility claim. Destroys has the body occurs ∧ terminal ∧ same target. Admissible universally suppresses blocked occurrence edges; LossCovered explicitly requires persistence or a represented terminal destruction; NoBypass requires all such terminal occurrences against this bearer to be blocked. These bodies separate protection, single-process interruption and bare threat-record deletion. No transitivity, asymmetry, well-foundedness, modal power or productive causal property is inferred. A sampled temporal model cannot supply q104's timeless direct conservation. No original sourced preservation sense is completed; its applicability and the original process/action interpretation remain open.
